title: credit.depleted payload v1
description: A draw took the holder's available balance of a feature from above zero to zero or below ("pack used up"). Made once per crossing. No postings: the draw's own event carries the balance move. Only a draw by the family's own activity makes it: a `track` (a booking's hold) or a `finalize`; never a refund or lost-dispute clawback (`applyBillingPlan`), an edit by hand, or a reset. Judged on the balance after holds: a cancel (`credit.released`) returns the credits with no event and booking again makes it again. atm does not remember that it already alerted: dedupe the notices per holder, feature and grant or cycle. Labelled with `feature`, not `plan`: the balance is the feature's total over every plan. The clock makes the same event (`lapseAlertEvents`, source `cron`) when rows lapse and take the total from above zero to zero or below: then `cause` is `expired` and there is no command or mutation: the two shapes are exclusive, so a payload with `cause` and a `command` or `mutation` is refused, and one without `cause` needs both.

available.description: The holder's available balance of the feature after the mutation, in the feature's credits.

threshold.description: Always null: running out does not depend on the low-credit threshold.

previous_available.description: The available balance before the mutation (above `available`: these events come from a draw).

cause.description: Absent: a draw made it. `expired`: rows lapsed by the clock took the available balance to zero or below (then `command` and `mutation` must be absent; `previous_available` is the balance just before the instant they lapsed).

slice.description: Positions in mutation.changes that this event is made from, when one mutation is booked as several events (one per feature and plan). Absent: all of them. The mutation is always the whole one.

complete.description: Written by a handler that logs every engine command it runs (after atm 0.3.0), so a revision with no event in the log was a write of the grants row alone. Absent on what 0.3.0 wrote, which did not log some commands.
